create_ObjectDetectionDataReader: create an ObjectDetectionDataReader instance with a data folder path for ONNX quantization calibration
run_ObjectDetectionDataReader_get_next: run the get_next method to retrieve the next batch of pixel values and target sizes from PNG images
test_ObjectDetectionDataReader_rewind: test the rewind method to reset the batch counter back to zero for re-iteration
review_ObjectDetectionDataReader_iter: review the __iter__ and __next__ methods to enable for-loop iteration over calibration data batches
